Additional information
Making an appointment and waiting time
Please make an appointment only when you are able to submit all of the required documents.
For visa application :
https://consulat.gouv.fr/en/bureau-francais-de-taipei/appointment?name=VISAS
For passport application :
https://consulat.gouv.fr/en/bureau-francais-de-taipei/appointment?name=Retrait%20de%20passeport%20-%20Visas
Waiting time for an appointment :
The average waiting time for an appointment for short and long-stay visas is
48 hours
This waiting time may be extended up to
20 working days
prior to and during summer time.
Likewise, an increase of applications is to be expected prior to winter school holidays. As getting an appointment may exceed the normal waiting time, applicants are encouraged to submit their visa application with sufficient anticipation to avoid having to postpone their departure.
This appointment procedure does not apply to students as their appointments are arranged directly by Campus France.
Security information
When visiting the French Office in Taipei, you must not possess any weapon or dangerous product. Security checks are carried out prior to admission into the premises.
The use of mobile phones, cameras or other audio or video recording devices is strictly prohibited. You will be asked to drop off your mobile phone in lockers provided for this purpose before entering the waiting room.
Public holidays / closures
Weekly closing on
Saturdays
and
Sundays
.
Holidays in 2026:
May 1st : Labour Day
June 19th : Dragon Boat Festival
September 25th : Mid-Autumn Festival
September 28th : Teacher's Day
October 9th : Compensatory leave for Taiwan National Day
October 26th : Compensatory leave for Retrocession Day
December 25th : Constitution Day
Practical informations on your appointment
Preparation
You must submit all the required documents on the day of your appointment. No document sent to the visa section by any other means will be accepted.
In order to prepare your visa application, please consult the list of documents required according to the purpose of your stay on the France-Visas website.
Please note that only visa service officers are authorized to request additional supporting documents and that no third party individual or organization is allowed in matters regarding visas.
Submitting your visa application
: visa applications must be submitted by the applicant itself at the visa section. The French Office in Taipei will not process any visa application received through mail or any other means.
Do not forget to bring with you :
Confirmation of your appointment (printed) ;
Your passport ;
Your photo which meets the ICAO standards and issued less than 6 months ago ;
The printed France-visas filled form ;
All the requested documents listed on the France-visas website.
Registration of biometric data
All visas delivered by France are biometric.
Visa applicants above the age of 12 years old must come to the visa section when submitting their first visa application. The following biometric identifiers will be collected: a photo (which must be less than 6 months old), will be scanned on the day of your appointment, and your fingerprints will be collected.
However, it is possible to recover your biometric data if a former Schengen visa has been issued within the preceding 59 months.
Children under the age of 12 are exempted from fingerprints collection. The visa application must be submitted by one of the child’s parents or by the person who holds parental authority. The child’s
ICAO-compliant photograph (pdf)
will then be scanned. The child must be present when submitting the visa application.
Track your application and collect your passport
You have to make an appointment to collect your passport on the following link :
https://consulat.gouv.fr/en/bureau-francais-de-taipei/appointment?name=Retrait%20de%20passeport%20-%20Visas
If you are unable to come to collect your passport, a third party with a power of attorney, your payment receipt, a copy of your ID and of his own ID may collect it for you.
Particular situations
Taiwanese passport holders
Holders of a Taiwanese passport
with their identity number written on it, who wish to travel to Europe to one or several Schengen member states are exempted from having a visa for touristic, family or business stays of less than 90 days.
France has extended this exemption for Taiwanese nationals traveling to France’s non-European territories : French overseas departments, and French overseas collectivities and territories.
Taiwanese nationals who hold of a Taiwanese passport which does not include their identity number must apply for a short stay visa.
People in possession of a passport which does not include their identity number must contact the French Office.
Official passports
Visas issued to holders of official passports in the course of their duties are free of charge.
Studying in France
Students wishing to study in France for a period exceeding 3 months are obliged to enroll on the website of Campus France beforehand and also complete the educational evaluation procedure (
Studies in France
) and only then may they submit their student visa application.
The mission of Campus France is to guide and advise Taiwanese students wishing to continue their studies in France. Campus France provides extensive information on all courses provided by French Higher education system as well as specific information regarding the different French establishments permitting students to build- with success, their journey of academic mobility.
Campus France allows you to construct a step-by-step project of your studies in France. Its website allows you to create an online personalized account as well as a place to discuss with
Campus France representatives
.
The visa section is in charge of processing visa applications according to the rules and regulations in force. It is not authorized to give any information regarding dossiers being processed by telephone.
Campus France procedure for studying in France is as follows:
Inscription
Create an
account
Online completion of your application
Payment of services charges via bank transfer
Interview and submitting Campus France application
Once the service charges have been validated, you may proceed by making an appointment online on the Campus France website. You simply need to choose the date and time which suits you amongst the time slots proposed on your personal online account.
During off-peak season, there are 3 working days waiting time. During high peak season, there might be up to 10 working days waiting time.
On the day of your appointment, you should come to the Campus France Office bringing with you all of the
documents required (pdf)
.
The educational interview consists of an oral presentation of your personal studies plan and answering questions from the counselors regarding your application file. The interview may be proceeded in French, English or Chinese depending on the course you have chosen.
Submitting your student visa application :
You may submit your visa application dossier the same day as your interview with Campus France - no appointment with the visa section is necessary in this case provided that your visa application dossier is complete. You must submit your dossier personally at one of the visa section counters where you biometric data will be registered.
Bring photocopies of all substantiating documents as there is no possibility of making photocopies on the premises.
Once your have paid the application fee (in cash or by Easy Card), you will receive a receipt and your visa application will be processed by the visa section.
Processing time:
Approximately three weeks. During the summer peak, the processing time is up to one month.
Help
In case of difficulties related to your visa application, consular services can be contacted
by email only
.

Visa, Residence permit
Depending on your nationality, your situation and the length of your stay, you may be able to obtain a visa to study or conduct research in France or to return here after you graduate.
France-Visas
France-Visas
is the official website for visa application to France.
Please connect to:
https://france-visas.gouv.fr/
You will find all information you need to prepare your stay in France.
Apply for a visa on France-Visas
France-Visas allows international students to submit digital copies of their supporting documents when they complete their online visa application. This new service is initially available to international students residing in countries where visa applications are outsourced and available online. It allows for an accelerated process at the external service provider.
Prerequisites for a digitalized visa application
To be eligible to submit a digitalized visa application, you must meet the following conditions:
Be an international student applying to study in France.
Be applying for a long-stay student visa only.
Reside in a country where an external service provider is available for visa application collection.
Steps for the online visa application
If you meet the prerequisites, you can complete your student visa application in 4 steps:
Fill out your online visa application on France-Visas and upload your documents.
Submit your passport and signed form in person at the collection center.
Track your application online on the service provider's website.
Collect your passport.

No visa obligation for European students
If you are a national of a European Economic Area country (European Union country (EU) and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein) or Switzerland,
you do not need a student visa to study or do an internship in France.
You may freely enter French territory regardless of the length of your stay or your studies.
On the other hand, you must have a sickness and maternity insurance and sufficient financial resources to meet your needs and those of any of your family you may be supporting.
Citizens of the EU/EEA/Switzerland may
work while studying in France
without a residency permit to a maximum of 964 hours per year.
The short stay student visa
If you are not a national of a European Economic Area country (European Union country and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein) or of Switzerland, and depending on your nationality, you must obtain a student visa to study in France
even if your stay is
less than 3 months
.
There are two types of short stay visa:
the "short stay for studies" (
court séjour pour études
) visa and the "student in competition"
(
étudiant concours
) visa, which should be requested if you are convoked by a French institute for an exam or interview.
Note that nationals from certain non-European countries are not required to have a visa if their stay does not exceed 90 days. Check the article "
The student visa short stay
"for more information on this subject.
The long stay student visa
If you are not a national of a European Economic Area country (European Union country and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein) or of Switzerland,
you must request a student long stay visa
to study, conduct research or do an internship in France
for more than 3 months
.
There are two types of long term visas:
1/ the Long Term Visa used as Residence Permit (VLS-TS)
This visa allows you to remain in France for one year without needing to request a residency permit. You will still have to have your visa approved on arrival. Depending on the nature of your stay,
there are three types of long stay visas
:
the
student VLS-TS
for studies at the Bachelor's and Master's level;
the
Talent passport VLS-TS
for a doctorate and beyond;
the
internship VLS-TS
to do an internship in France as part of the programme you are enrolled in in your country of residence.
2/ the Temporary Long Term Visa (VLS-T)
With the
VLS-T
, you can stay in France for 1 year, and you don’t need to validate it at your arrival. It cannot be renewed, and it doesn’t grant the rights than the VLS-TS.
The Working Holiday visa
In the framework of a reciprocal agreement with several countries,
France grants Working Holiday visas
(vacances-travail)
.
Reserved for young people aged 18 to 30, they let you spend one year in France to learn about the country without studying here. They let you work in France to round out your resources during the year.
Check the article "
Working Holiday visa
" to find out if you are eligible for this and for more information on the subject.
Provisional residency permit
If you are not a national of a European Economic Area country (European Union country and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein) or of Switzerland,
the
Autorisation Provisoire de Séjour
(APS - Provisional Residency Permit)
allows you to remain one year in France after you graduate.
It is reserved for holders of a professional Bachelor's, a Master's-level degree and all graduates who are starting a company.
The travel visa or Schengen visa
If you are not
a national of a European Economic Area country (European Union country and Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein) or of Switzerland, you can request a
travel visa
at the end of your studies. Reserved for holders of a Master's-level degree from a French higher education institute, it allows you to regularly return to France if you reside in another country after your studies in France.
Student visa: Campus France answers your questions
Regardless of your situation or nationality, check the following articles to find the answers to your questions concerning student visas:
How do I appeal a decision to refuse a visa?
How do I validate my visa on arrival?
How do I renew my residency permit?

法國教育中心面試所需文件 
Documents à présenter à l’entretien Campus France 
 
1. 有效護照正本。護照的有效日期須於赴法學習計畫結束後仍至少有三個月的效期。 
Votre passeport en cours de validité. La date de fin de validité doit être postérieure d’au moins 
3 mois à la date de fin de validité du visa sollicité. 
 
2. 法國學校開立之具名（預）註冊證明。請依以下符合您的身份準備： 
A. 由本中心線上系統申請學校者：請直接從法國教育中心線上系統下載您的（預）註冊證明。 
B. 已自行取得入學資格者 ：請務必提供載明學程名稱與就學期限的(預)註冊證明紙本正本， 並附
上影本一份。原則上，法國學校(預)註冊證明必須要有校方的親手簽名與蓋章。如果您的文件之
簽章為印製上去 ， 請務必保留好文件的信封 ， 並於面試當天將文件與信封一併出示 。唯交換/雙聯
學生可以電子檔列印出之版本送件。 
Attestation de (pré)-inscription nominative établie par un établissement français :  
A. Pour ceux postulant via la plateforme « É tudes en France » : l’attestation de (pré)-inscription 
est à télécharger en ligne.  
B. Pour les autres étudiants, l’attestation ORIGINALE de l’établissement mentionnant le nom 
du diplôme préparé ainsi que la durée des études (photocopie acceptée uniquement pour les 
étudiants d’é change). Veuillez noter que la signature manuscrite  ainsi que le cachet de 
l’établissement sont deux éléments indispensables qui doivent être portés sur l’attestation 
présentée. À  défaut d’une signature manuscrite, merci de bien vouloir conserver l’enveloppe 
du courrier reçu lors de votre entretien. 
 
3. 英文或法文最高學歷（畢業證書或在學證明）正本，並附上影本一份。 
Dernier diplôme obtenu ou attestation d’inscription pour ceux qui sont en cours d’études. 
 
 
備註:學生辦理簽證統一透過法國教育中心線上系統預約時間。已自行取得入學資格者，請務必備妥辦理簽證所需資料，
以便於面試結束送件辦理簽證。 
NB : La prise de rendez-vous pour demande de visa pour études est gérée directement par Campus France. Le dépôt 
du dossier de demande de visa peut avoir lieu le même jour que l’entretien Campus Franc à condition que votre dossier 
de demande de visa soit complet.

台北市敦化北路205號10樓 (民生東路口) 
T：02 - 2712 1233 Email：taipei@campusfrance.org 
對外開放時間：周一至周五 下午2~4點

OUR DIFFERENT
SERVICES
Onboarding    
Each semester, our school organizes orientation for both 
local and international students. Throughout your first days 
with us, you will be invited to many activities to get to know 
one another. We will also help you through administrative 
formalities. Our goal is to provide information and help 
students deal with day-to-day life issues while studying at 
EM Normandie.
Accessibility and 
equal opportunities
With students’ wellbeing at heart, a department is dedicated 
to equal rights, diversity, and opportunities. The school 
ensures all students a great experience each step of the 
way and helps accommodate students with disabilities. 
EM Normandie’s is to allow all its students to explore their 
potential whatever, regardless of their situation. Committed 
since 2008 through the Handicap Charter of the Conférence 
des Grandes Ecole (CGE) renewed in 2019, the school 
reinforces its commitment to the inclusion of students with 
disabilities and implements a whole series of measures to 
improve their daily lives. 
Orientation/career
This department is dedicated to helping students navigate 
and make informed decisions about their career paths 
during their time at the university and beyond. This 
department provides a range or resources and support 
to assist students in export potential careers, developing 
relevant skills, and successfully transitioning from academic 
life to the professional world. 
Well-being
We have the Balance and Inclusion department focused 
on promoting diversity, equity and inclusion within the 
academic community. The primary goal of such a service 
is to create an environment where all students, faculty 
and staff feel valued, respected and included. This service 
plays a crucial rôle in fostering an inclusive and equitable 
university environment, contributing to a positive learning 
and working experience for everyone involved.

STUDENT 
CLUBS
Student clubs bring extra dynamism to EM 
Normandie’s campuses by offering exciting 
events and projects in all domains: culture, 
sports, humanitarian and professional 
activities, or just for fun. 
Exchange students can enjoy all these activities anytime 
throughout the semester but in order to participate in projects 
they will need to be enrolled in a year exchange program.
BDA : Bureau Des Arts (arts & culture club). 
The BDA aims to promote art and culture in all its forms to 
students: music, painting, literature, cinema ...
BDS : Bureau Des Sports (sports club). 
The BDS offers numerous sports activities, competitions 
and events both within the school and outside. 
BDE : Bureau Des Étudiants (students club). 
The BDE’s mission is to integrate all the EMiens and make 
them enjoy their student life as much as possible, thanks 
to campus activities and convivial evenings.

original_evidence.text:
National Central University 
 
 
 
 
 
桃園市中壢區中大路 300 號 300,Jhongda Rd., Jhongli Dist., Taoyuan City, Taiwan 320 
Tel: +886-3-4207107 / +886-3-4207094 / Fax: +886-3-4203384  
 www.ncu.edu.tw / ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw 
國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。 
 
 
 
□我已閱讀並同意上述所有內容。 
申請人簽名:___________________ 
簽名日期:_____________________

國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

Head of International Office Ms Hannelore GUERRAND – mobility@eigsi.fr 
Incoming students Coordinator Ms Victoria Fouré-Fournier 
mobility@eigsi.fr 
Phone: +33 5 46 45 78 57 
 
ADMISSION PROCEDURE  
1. The Home Institution nominates the students to EIGSI through email - mobility@eigsi.fr  
2. The students upload the application documents on a provided Google Form. 
3. The decision on your application will be communicated within 2 weeks after the application deadline. 
 
NOMINATION: Deadlines and procedures  
For Universities : 
The home university sends an email with the name and email address of selected students to mobility@eigsi.fr 
DEADLINE FOR NOMINATION DEADLINE FOR APPLICATION DOCUMENTS 
Fall semester – 15 May Fall semester – 31 May 
Spring semester – 11 October Spring semester – 01 November 
 
For Students: 
Nominated students apply for admission by sending the following documents :  
In the Google Form EIGSI will send, the following documents are requested: 
• Curriculum vitae 
• Last Transcript of records 
• Copy of ID card or passport 
• Photograph (passport size) 
• English test proficiency (official certificate): B2 Level – mandatory 
• French test Proficiency (letter from a French teacher): A2 level - minimum recommended for daily life  
 
Concerning the learning agreement: 
 Learning agreement Typewritten - for non-Erasmus+ Students 
 Online Learning Agreement for Erasmus+ Students: https://learning-agreement.eu/

EIGSI 拉羅歇爾工程學校 
地點 26 RUE DE VAUX DE FOLETIE, 17041 LA ROCHELLE CEDEX 1, France 
 
學校簡介 法國高等教育體系中的 Ecole d'Ingénieurs 為理工精英學院，學生畢業後可獲頒由「法
國工程學院校長聯盟」（CDEFI）頒發的「工程師文憑」，此文憑定期由「工程師文憑委
員會」審核並受到國家認可。獲得「工程師文憑」者等同取得法國家碩士學位，臺灣
教育部也承認(文章出處:法國教育中心留學刊物) 
EIGSI 拉羅歇爾工程學校 EIGSI Ecole d'Ingénieurs de La Rochelle 為法國理工精英學院之
一，學校位於法國著名海濱城市拉羅歇爾(La Rochelle)，是一所集機械、工業化、自動
化、電子、電氣、計算機、工業工程等工程專業學生的學校。

original_evidence.text:
PRACTICAL INFORMATION 
 
ACCOMMODATION 
 
 
EIGSI does not offer housing for exchange students but provides information and a list of external 
accommodations. 
Useful address : 
All the information related to accommodation in La Rochelle is available on the school website: 
https://www.eigsi.fr/campus-life/accomodation/?lang=en 
Contact: 
Housing department - Phone. +33 5 46 45 80 05 – email : logement@eigsi.fr 
 
 
 
VISA 
 
Resident permit 
 
European Students:  
Students from a country within the European Union do not need residency permits but must have a valid National 
Identity Card and/or passport. 
 
 
Non-European Students: 
International students from a country outside the European Union must have a long stay visa.  
A pre-registration certificate is provided at the start of Campus France procedures. 
 
The procedure to validate their residence permit must be made ONLINE within 3 months at the latest after their 
arrival. They must have a personal postal address in France and a French bankcard. This validation is essential to 
stay in France on a regular basis. 
 
The visa is usually valid for one year. 
 
Office Français de l’Immigration et de l’Intégration (OFII - French Immigration Office):  
Immediately upon arrival at EIGSI, and also within 3 months after their arrival, students will carry out procedures 
required by OFII, pay the tax online (tax of 1st issue: 50 €) and validate their Long Stay Visa.  
This is done on the validation website: https://administration-etrangers-en-france.interieur.gouv.fr/particuliers/#/ 
Online payment by Credit card (Visa/Mastercard). 
 
After payment of the fee, the visa will be validated. A certificate will be sent by email. 
Students must keep this certificate carefully. It will be necessary for other procedures.

學校簡介 
IDRAC Business School is signatory to the ERASMUS Charter and offers Study Abroad programs to all his 
partners with 2 programs fully taught in English and 1 in French. 
All of them are course packages: students can get up to 30 ECTS in each program. Each student can 
choose the program that best fits his needs but cannot mix courses from different programs in order to avoid 
schedule clashes. 
The IDRAC Business School BBA program in English is opened in Lyon and Paris for fall and spring 
semesters. Bordeaux, Montpellier and Nantes campuses open for spring semester. The program in French 
is available on 9 different campuses. 
The PGE in English is opened in Lyon both during fall and spring semesters and allows to be mixed up with 
French students. This program received the Grade de Master (one of the highest recognition given by the 
Ministry of education to a program in France). 
All our programs offer the possibility to learn French as a foreign language. Students can enroll in the French 
seminar at the start of the semester, intensive seminar in French. And classes are programmed regularly 
during the semester.

original_evidence.text:
Deadline nomination & Application 
Fall Spring 
June 1st November 5th 
 
1) Students must be nominated by their home university via the nomination form (sent previously by IDRAC in the 
email “call for nominations”.). The home university must send the nomination form by email to: incoming@reseau-
cd.fr 
2) We will send a confirmation email to the home university with the application procedure: 
a) Students must complete the online form 
b) The home university must send by email the required documents to: incoming@reseau-cd.fr 
- A copy of the student’s passport or ID card if European (page with picture and name) 
- Student’s official ID picture (jpg) (white background, facing the camera) 
- Most recent transcripts of records (with an English or a French translation) 
- Proof of B2 level in English or French. 
 
 
Programs taught in English (except summer sessions): B2 (TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS)/ If the student does not have one

國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

IDRAC Business School is signatory to the ERASMUS Charter and offers Study Abroad programs to all his 
partners with 2 programs fully taught in English and 1 in French.

choose the program that best fits his needs but cannot mix courses from different programs in order to avoid 
schedule clashes. 
The IDRAC Business School BBA program in English is opened in Lyon and Paris for fall and spring 
semesters. Bordeaux, Montpellier and Nantes campuses open for spring semester. The program in French 
is available on 9 different campuses. 
The PGE in English is opened in Lyon both during fall and spring semesters and allows to be mixed up with 
French students. This program received the Grade de Master (one of the highest recognition given by the 
Ministry of education to a program in France).

Deadline nomination & Application 
Fall Spring 
June 1st November 5th 
 
1) Students must be nominated by their home university via the nomination form (sent previously by IDRAC in the 
email “call for nominations”.). The home university must send the nomination form by email to: incoming@reseau-
cd.fr 
2) We will send a confirmation email to the home university with the application procedure: 
a) Students must complete the online form 
b) The home university must send by email the required documents to: incoming@reseau-cd.fr 
- A copy of the student’s passport or ID card if European (page with picture and name) 
- Student’s official ID picture (jpg) (white background, facing the camera) 
- Most recent transcripts of records (with an English or a French translation) 
- Proof of B2 level in English or French. 
 
 
Programs taught in English (except summer sessions): B2 (TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS)/ If the student does not have one 
of the above certificates, we can accept an official written letter from the home university attesting that the student’s level 
in English is sufficient to study academic courses. 
 
Programs taught in French: B2 official certificate (TCF, ETEF, DELF). 
 
 
IDRAC does not have campus accommodation. However, IDRAC provides a list of accommodations. If interested, students 
should contact the residence directly. 
 
The cost of student accommodation in France can vary according to city and location. For Paris, average costs are around 
€800 per month, and around €500 in the other cities. 
 
 
Students are required to provide a copy of their International Health lnsurance Certificate (covering repatriation, civil liability 
and extra medical costs) as well as: 
EU-residents: a valid copy of your European Health lnsurance Card (EHIC) 
Non-EU residents: a certificate proving that you applied for the French Health Scheme (Sécurité Sociale). lt is mandatory 
and free. Register online (English website) at https://etudiant -etranger.ameli.fr/#/ (you'II need your birth certificate to 
register). You can watch this video for details about the registration process. More information in the Student Handbook 
p.4. 
 
 
Check if a student visa is requested using this official visa website (available in French or in English) at https://france -
visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/ The VLS-TS student visa allows to pursue studies in France for a period of four months 
to one year. More information in the Student Handbook p.3. 
 
 
For more information, please contact us: incoming@reseau-cd.fr

Students are required to provide a copy of their International Health lnsurance Certificate (covering repatriation, civil liability 
and extra medical costs) as well as:

and free. Register online (English website) at https://etudiant -etranger.ameli.fr/#/ (you'II need your birth certificate to 
register). You can watch this video for details about the registration process. More information in the Student Handbook 
p.4. 
 
 
Check if a student visa is requested using this official visa website (available in French or in English) at https://france -
visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/ The VLS-TS student visa allows to pursue studies in France for a period of four months 
to one year. More information in the Student Handbook p.3.

original_evidence.text:
3. ACCOMMODATION
Long-term accommodation
Below is a list of websites offering housing in the cities where our campuses are 
located. The rent depends on where you live, type of housing and surface area. You 
can also find more information on Campus France website.
My Studapart is a dedicated platform for student accommodation. It provides a list of 
housing (individual flat or flatshares) located in private student residences close to our
campuses. Available in French, English and Chinese, it is a very easy tool which offers a 
technical assistance 6/7 days. All our international students are eligible to the 
Studapart guarantee (which replaces a guarantor) over the entire duration of their stay. 
Housing Anywhere provides a list of housing (studios, apartments, private room, 
shared room) available for rent or sublet. Offers come from students who rent their 
rooms, private landlords, host families, housing operators (agencies, residences...).
Important:  To avoid scams, we strongly recommend you to visit the flat before signing the 
lease. Do not pay anything before signing the lease. If the landlord is a private owner, always 
ask for his/her personal information (name, surname, phone number and ID number). 
Be extra careful if the monthly rent is lower than market price.
Short-term accommodation
For your first nights, we recommend you to book a hotel or Airbnb. Then, take the 
time to visit several options before choosing your long-term accommodation.
What is VISALE?
Most of the time, having a French guarantor (who commits to paying the rent in 
case the student faces financial difficulties) is necessary to sign a lease. VISALE is 
a free rental deposit, which cover students for the duration of the lease. It is 
accessible to all international students (Europeans or holders of a visa VLS-TS).  
The VISALE subscription must be done before the signature of the lease.
How to register?
Watch this video for more information about Visale’s procedures. 
6
Tips: you may be eligible for the French housing allowance
Erasmus Play is a search engine and comparator of student accommodation 
throughout Europe. It allows you to quickly and easily compare all available 
accommodations. Moreover, you will be able to make your reservation in total 
security since all the accommodations come from verified platforms.
LivinFrance provides accommodation and services for exchange students looking 
for a roommate. No guarantor is required. If you take a pack “Livin-France”, you 
will have access to services such as check-in inventory, legal advice, maintenance 
reactivity 72h.
Tips: :  If you do not have a French guarantor, it is also possible to pay your rent in 
advance for several months. In this case, please do ask for an official payment 
receipt.

In France, the National Health Scheme (named Sécurité Sociale) 
reimburses your medical expenses if you are ill, injured or hospitalized. 
Before your arrival in France, you are required to send the following documents at 
incoming@reseau-cd.fr
When to apply for Sécurité Sociale?
Upon your arrival in France, and after receiving your school registration 
certificate.
How to apply for Sécurité Sociale?
To complete your registration online, you will have to upload several official 
documents and a bank account statement - IBAN (you do not need to have a 
French bank account).
 Watch this video about the procedure to register for Sécurité Sociale
A copy of your International Health Insurance Certificate for repatriation, civil 
liability and extra medical cost.

Study Abroad Department emailed it to you).
EU students: a valid copy of your European Health Insurance Card

Sociale). This can be done upon your arrival. It is free but mandatory. Please 
register at etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr (English website) and send us your registration 
certificate.
Important: Please note that these documents are mandatory. You will not be able 
to get your Student card if you did not provide them.

Tips: It is easier to find a job if you speak French.
9. JOBS
If you have a student visa VLS-TS, you will be able to work part-time in 
France (up to 20 hours/ week).
To find a job, the best option is to print your resume (with your contact 
details) and go directly to nearby restaurants, hotels, small shops to apply. 
When visiting, leave your resume so that they can contact you later.
10. SUPPORT FROM STUDENT ORGANISATIONS
Several student organisations offer networking possibilities as well as various activities 
to discover France.
ESN (Erasmus Student Network) welcomes all international students with special 
events to help you discover the city, meet other students, answer your questions... If 
you register for the Buddy System, you will have the opportunity to get a French 
sponsor. A sponsor is a student who volunteers to help foreign students when they 
arrive in France. They may help you to complete your first administrative procedures 
and become familiar with French culture.
Erasmus Place is a platform designed to help international students with
accommodation, administrative procedures, jobs, etc. ! The organisation organizes
events all around France and provides tips about good places to see in various French
cities.

Montpellier : ESN Montpellier FB Group
Paris : ESN Paris FB Group

furnitures or kitchen utensils for your housing for free! You can email them

7. BANKING
9
8. POST OFFICE
In France, you’ll notice that you need to use post office to mail most of 
official documents. The French postal service company is called “La Poste”.
Click here to know more about their services (in French). Opening hours vary 
between post offices.
International students are allowed to get a French bank account. It can be very handy 
in your day-to-day life.
Having an account in a French bank avoids paying charges and fees from your home 
country bank. You’ll also get a chequebook from a French bank which is very useful to 
make payments – including your rent.
Three documents are needed to open a bank account: identification, proof of 
residence and an attestation of enrolment or a student card.
        To know more about the procedure, watch this video.
Tips: Make sure you arrive with a sufficient amount of cash (euros) for your first 
current expenditures in case your bank card is not accepted.
If needed, your family or friends can send you money from your country via Western 
Union.

original_evidence.text:
National Central University 
 
 
 
 
 
桃園市中壢區中大路 300 號 300,Jhongda Rd., Jhongli Dist., Taoyuan City, Taiwan 320 
Tel: +886-3-4207107 / +886-3-4207094 / Fax: +886-3-4203384  
 www.ncu.edu.tw / ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw 
國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。 
 
 
 
□我已閱讀並同意上述所有內容。

city.label: 城市與校區位置
city.note: 中央未年介紹為巴黎天主教大學ICP，21 Rue d’Assas、Paris75006法國；不是里爾、里昂等其他天主教院校。

original_evidence.text:
Institut Catholique de Paris (ICP) 巴黎天主教大學 
地點 
  
21 Rue d'Assas, 75006 Paris, 法國 
簡介(出處:
維基百科) 
巴黎天主教大學提供本科到博士的教育。校名有時也譯為巴黎天主教學院，歐陸學術界口
語習慣稱呼這所歷史悠久的學校 La Catho. 學校頒發的文憑有教廷文憑（或稱宗座文憑，
diplôme canonique） 、國家文憑（diplôme d' Eta） 、學院文憑（diplôme universitaire/diplôme 
de l'institut，由該學院自行頒授之文憑） 。在歐洲具有高聲譽和歷史傳統的一所宗座大學，
屬於 UDESCA（天主教高等教育機構聯盟）成員，該學術聯盟包括五個法國天主教學院-
巴黎，里爾，里昂，昂熱和土魯斯，同時是國際天主教大學聯合會（FIUC）成員之一。 
申請資格 Undergraduate/Graduate 
課程 Most of Faculty courses are delivered in French. The maximum study load per semester is 30 ECTS. For 
each ECTS, you should count with 25 to 30 working 
hours. Please check our French course catalogue: 
https://www.icp.fr/international/venir-etudier-alicp/catalogue-des-cours or the English page: 
https://en.icp.fr/programs/course-catalog-1 
From September 2023, the ICP offers courses in English within its Faculty of Liberal Arts and its Faculty 
of Social Sciences, Economics and Law to exchange students. 
Please check our English-taught courses catalogue: https://en.icp.fr/programs/english-taught-courses 
Please note: The Faculty of Theology, the Faculty of Canon Law, the Faculty of Philosophy, and the 
Faculty 
of Education do not offer any courses in English. 
 
有提供英語授課課程學院: 
Faculty of Social Sciences, Economics and Law/ Faculty of Liberal Arts

國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

original_evidence.text:
Institut Catholique de Paris (ICP) 巴黎天主教大學 
地點 
  
21 Rue d'Assas, 75006 Paris, 法國 
簡介(出處:
維基百科) 
巴黎天主教大學提供本科到博士的教育。校名有時也譯為巴黎天主教學院，歐陸學術界口
語習慣稱呼這所歷史悠久的學校 La Catho. 學校頒發的文憑有教廷文憑（或稱宗座文憑，
diplôme canonique） 、國家文憑（diplôme d' Eta） 、學院文憑（diplôme universitaire/diplôme 
de l'institut，由該學院自行頒授之文憑） 。在歐洲具有高聲譽和歷史傳統的一所宗座大學，
屬於 UDESCA（天主教高等教育機構聯盟）成員，該學術聯盟包括五個法國天主教學院-
巴黎，里爾，里昂，昂熱和土魯斯，同時是國際天主教大學聯合會（FIUC）成員之一。 
申請資格 Undergraduate/Graduate 
課程 Most of Faculty courses are delivered in French. The maximum study load per semester is 30 ECTS. For 
each ECTS, you should count with 25 to 30 working 
hours. Please check our French course catalogue: 
https://www.icp.fr/international/venir-etudier-alicp/catalogue-des-cours or the English page: 
https://en.icp.fr/programs/course-catalog-1 
From September 2023, the ICP offers courses in English within its Faculty of Liberal Arts and its Faculty 
of Social Sciences, Economics and Law to exchange students. 
Please check our English-taught courses catalogue: https://en.icp.fr/programs/english-taught-courses 
Please note: The Faculty of Theology, the Faculty of Canon Law, the Faculty of Philosophy, and the 
Faculty 
of Education do not offer any courses in English. 
 
有提供英語授課課程學院: 
Faculty of Social Sciences, Economics and Law/ Faculty of Liberal Arts

Undergraduate/Graduate 
學校簡介
（出處:維
基百科） 
國立土魯斯應用科學學院是一所位於法國西南城市土魯斯的工程師類大學，屬於法國國
立應用科學學院（INSA）集團五所學校的一所。學校創立於 1963 年，屬土魯斯大學
（Université de Toulouse）聯盟學校之一。是一所工程師教育及科學研究為一體的大學。
該校由法國高等教育部以及負責頒發工程師文憑的法國工程師教育協會授權，負責工程
師培養和科學研究工作。 INSA 土魯斯的工程師學位課程學制為學+碩共五年。

項目 說明 
申請表 請務必完成簽核 
家長同意書(必繳) 請務必由家長親筆簽名 
個資同意書(必繳)

補繳

妹校是否有規定，均應於校內申請時具
備並繳交外語檢定考試成績（不限成績
級數） ：《英文檢定成績需為二年內效
期》 
⚫ 托福 TOEFL iBT/ITP 
⚫ 雅思 IELTS（學術組） 
⚫ 全民英檢 GEPT（複試通過） 
⚫ 多益 TOEIC（包含聽讀） 
⚫ 領思（實用組） 
⚫ 培力英檢 
3. 或志願校接受之第三外語檢定成績

中文版歷年成績單(必繳) 1. 請至註冊組申請

無法出具者視同未獲校內錄取資格。 
其他能力證明或個人作品(選繳)  
以上兩步驟皆需完成才算完成整個申請程序，請注意繳件時間，逾期或資料不

其他能力證明或個人作品(選繳)

全，於申請截止日後將不予受理!

➢ Courses 
In France, normal full-time degrees require 30 ECTS per semester . Exchange students may take less credits if their 
university allows it. 
Exchange students can join one of the following programs:  
• Aero 3 (undergraduate level courses, Fall and Spring semesters) – English or French tracks 
• Aero 4 (graduate level courses, Spring semester) – English track 
• Aero 5 (graduate level courses, Fall semester) – English track except for Management option 
The updated lists of courses are sent to the nominated students as soon as it is available. 
➢ Health insurance and Civil liability 
EU-students: A valid European Health insurance Card (EHIC) for the duration of our stay in France is mandatory. You 
must present it at your arrival.  A complementary health insurance is recommended. 
Non-EU-students: You must enroll in the French student social security scheme (free) once in France.  A 
complementary health insurance is recommended.  
A civil liability (third-party liability) is mandatory for all students. 
➢ Other information 
• Cultural activities with the international student association 
• Free French lessons and intercultural courses 
• More than 90 clubs related to space, drones, robotics, sports…  
• A buddy system to help international students throughout their academic mobility 
➢ Visa 
https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/ 
This website provides information on how to navigate each step of visa application process.  
➢ Language requirements 
Aero 3: A B2 level in the selected language (French or English) is recommended. 
Aero 4 and Aero 5 (except Management): A B2 level in English is recommended. 
Aero 5 (Management option): A B2 level in English and French is recommended. 
TOEIC: 700/990 ; TOEFL: 70/120 ; IELTS: 5/9 ; Duolingo: 100/160 ; students with no official English test can provide a letter from 
their university stating they have sufficient knowledge in English to follow courses abroad. 
➢ Cost of living 
Incoming students can benefit from our partner’s dedicated student housing platform. They will have access to 
hundreds of offers including student residencies… and benefit from personalized support throughout their rent!   
BUDGET 
 Tuition fee Waived  
 Student health insurance (French social security) Free 
 Accommodation 600-900€ / month 
 Food 300€ / month 
 Transportation 32€ / month 
 Visa – VLS-TS (4 months to 1 year) 50€ 
ALLOWANCES AND SCHOLARSHIPS 
 Personal housing allowance (APL) : All students  (from the Europe an Union  only) 
renting an accommodation in France can receive APL. 
Up to 210€ / month 
 Scholarships: Please contact the Campus France office in your country

National Central University 
 
 
 
 
 
桃園市中壢區中大路 300 號 300,Jhongda Rd., Jhongli Dist., Taoyuan City, Taiwan 320 
Tel: +886-3-4207107 / +886-3-4207094 / Fax: +886-3-4203384  
 www.ncu.edu.tw / ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw 
國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。

Admission requirements

Study Abroad at IPSA
Experience Aerospace Engineering in France for One Semester
The Institut Polytechnique des Sciences Avancées (IPSA) is a top-ranked French engineering school fully dedicated to aerospace, aeronautics, space systems, drones and advanced technologies.
Through its
Study Abroad Program
, IPSA welcomes international students whose home universities do not have an exchange agreement with IPSA and who wish to study in France for one academic semester.
With campuses in Paris and Toulouse, IPSA offers a unique academic and cultural experience at the heart of Europe’s aerospace ecosystem.
Why Choose IPSA?
100% Aerospace-focused engineering school
International environment with English-taught programs
Strong links with the aerospace and space industry
Project-based learning and hands-on engineering approach
Dedicated international student support
Study in France while benefiting from free French classes
Recognized academic excellence since 1961
Available Programs
Aero 3 (Undergraduate Level) –
Paris Campus only
English or French pathways available
Aero 4 (Graduate Level)
–
Paris and Toulouse Campus
Spring semester only – English-taught
Aero 5 (Graduate Level)
–
Paris and Toulouse Campus
Fall semester: English-taught (except Management option)
Study Abroad students join IPSA as full-time students and follow regular academic courses alongside degree-seeking students.
A standard semester corresponds to 30 ECTS credits. Students may take fewer credits if approved by their home institution.
Semester dates
Fall semester:
September to January
Spring semester:
February to June
Orientation Days take place
one week before
the start of each semester.
How to Apply

courses.note: 第一、二年課不開放交換；Aero3、4、5及semester限制分開，常態30 ECTS，可經母校同意減修。官網課单2024–25仍舊，不作2027保證開課。 【2026–27資料表第2頁】Aero 3學士課程春秋皆開英語或法語組；Aero 4研究所課程僅春季英語組；Aero 5研究所課程僅秋季，管理方向的英法語要求另列。更新課單由校方向已提名者提供，不能把舊學年方案表當2027–28可修課保證。

original_evidence.text:
➢ Courses 
In France, normal full-time degrees require 30 ECTS per semester . Exchange students may take less credits if their 
university allows it. 
Exchange students can join one of the following programs:  
• Aero 3 (undergraduate level courses, Fall and Spring semesters) – English or French tracks 
• Aero 4 (graduate level courses, Spring semester) – English track 
• Aero 5 (graduate level courses, Fall semester) – English track except for Management option 
The updated lists of courses are sent to the nominated students as soon as it is available. 
➢ Health insurance and Civil liability 
EU-students: A valid European Health insurance Card (EHIC) for the duration of our stay in France is mandatory. You 
must present it at your arrival.  A complementary health insurance is recommended. 
Non-EU-students: You must enroll in the French student social security scheme (free) once in France.  A 
complementary health insurance is recommended.  
A civil liability (third-party liability) is mandatory for all students. 
➢ Other information 
• Cultural activities with the international student association 
• Free French lessons and intercultural courses 
• More than 90 clubs related to space, drones, robotics, sports…  
• A buddy system to help international students throughout their academic mobility 
➢ Visa 
https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/ 
This website provides information on how to navigate each step of visa application process.  
➢ Language requirements 
Aero 3: A B2 level in the selected language (French or English) is recommended. 
Aero 4 and Aero 5 (except Management): A B2 level in English is recommended. 
Aero 5 (Management option): A B2 level in English and French is recommended. 
TOEIC: 700/990 ; TOEFL: 70/120 ; IELTS: 5/9 ; Duolingo: 100/160 ; students with no official English test can provide a letter from 
their university stating they have sufficient knowledge in English to follow courses abroad. 
➢ Cost of living 
Incoming students can benefit from our partner’s dedicated student housing platform. They will have access to 
hundreds of offers including student residencies… and benefit from personalized support throughout their rent!   
BUDGET 
 Tuition fee Waived  
 Student health insurance (French social security) Free 
 Accommodation 600-900€ / month 
 Food 300€ / month 
 Transportation 32€ / month 
 Visa – VLS-TS (4 months to 1 year) 50€ 
ALLOWANCES AND SCHOLARSHIPS 
 Personal housing allowance (APL) : All students  (from the Europe an Union  only) 
renting an accommodation in France can receive APL. 
Up to 210€ / month 
 Scholarships: Please contact the Campus France office in your country

Admission requirements
The

from non-partner universities

Un étudiant peut-il bénéficier d'une aide au logement (APL, ALS, ALF) pour payer son loyer ?
Vérifié le 01 juillet 2026 - Service Public / Direction de l'information légale et administrative (Premier ministre)
Oui,
un étudiant peut bénéficier sous conditions d'une aide au logement pour l'aider à payer son loyer.
Il existe
3 types d'aides
au logement :
Aide personnalisée au logement (APL)
Allocation de logement familiale (ALF)
Allocation de logement sociale (ALS)
.
Vous pouvez bénéficier de
l'une de ces 3 aides
si vous respectez les
4 conditions suivantes
:
Vous êtes français, ou étranger avec un
titre de séjour
en cours de validité
Vous louez un
logement décent
Vous n'avez pas
de lien de parenté avec le propriétaire du logement
Vous avez de faibles ressources.
Depuis le 1
er
juillet 2026
, si vous êtes étudiant ressortissant d'un pays hors
Union européenne (UE)
: titleContent
,
Espace économique européen (EEE)
: titleContent
ou Suisse et possédez un titre de séjour délivré pour les études, vous pouvez bénéficier d’une aide au logement uniquement dans l'un des 3 cas suivants :
Vous percevez une
bourse sur critères sociaux
(du centre régional des œuvres universitaires et scolaires - Crous, ou une bourse régionale sanitaire et sociale alignée sur les critères sociaux)
Vous exercez une activité professionnelle
Vous êtes engagé dans un
contrat d’apprentissage ou de professionnalisation
.
Vous pouvez utiliser un simulateur pour avoir une estimation du montant de l'aide au logement auquel vous pouvez prétendre :
Calculer son droit à une aide personnelle au logement (APL, ALF, ALS) - Caf
Attention
Si vos parents perçoivent des allocations familiales et que vous demandez une aide au logement, vous n'êtes plus considéré à la
charge de vos parents au sens des prestations familiales
. Leurs allocations peuvent diminuer, voire être supprimées. Vous devez donc
choisir entre bénéficier d'une aide au logement ou rester à la charge de vos parents
.
Votre demande d'aide au logement doit être faite en ligne :
Aide au logement étudiant : demande en ligne
Il est recommandé de faire votre demande d'aide au logement dès l'installation dans votre logement.
En cas de
colocation
, chaque colocataire peut bénéficier d'une aide au logement. Il faut alors que chacun fasse sa propre demande à son nom. Le calcul de l'aide au logement prend en compte la part de loyer versée par chacun.

Pour plus d'informations, vous pouvez appeler le numéro dédié aux aides au logement étudiant.

Aide au logement étudiant (APL, ALF, ALS)
Permet aux étudiants d'obtenir des informations sur les aides au logement (APL, ALS, ALF).

09 69 32 52 52

er
paiement de l'aide au logement est généralement effectué
2 mois après la demande
.
Exemple :
Si la demande est faite en février, votre droit est ouvert en mars et le 1
er
paiement s'effectue début avril.

garantie Visale

l'avance Loca-Pass

l'aide Mobili-Jeune
(aide pour payer son loyer) sont cumulables avec l'APL, l'ALF ou l'ALS,
à condition de respecter les critères d'attribution de chaque dispositif

➢ Courses 
In France, normal full-time degrees require 30 ECTS per semester . Exchange students may take less credits if their 
university allows it. 
Exchange students can join one of the following programs:  
• Aero 3 (undergraduate level courses, Fall and Spring semesters) – English or French tracks 
• Aero 4 (graduate level courses, Spring semester) – English track 
• Aero 5 (graduate level courses, Fall semester) – English track except for Management option 
The updated lists of courses are sent to the nominated students as soon as it is available. 
➢ Health insurance and Civil liability 
EU-students: A valid European Health insurance Card (EHIC) for the duration of our stay in France is mandatory. You 
must present it at your arrival.  A complementary health insurance is recommended. 
Non-EU-students: You must enroll in the French student social security scheme (free) once in France.  A 
complementary health insurance is recommended.  
A civil liability (third-party liability) is mandatory for all students.

• Cultural activities with the international student association 
• Free French lessons and intercultural courses 
• More than 90 clubs related to space, drones, robotics, sports…  
• A buddy system to help international students throughout their academic mobility

https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/ 
This website provides information on how to navigate each step of visa application process.

Aero 3: A B2 level in the selected language (French or English) is recommended. 
Aero 4 and Aero 5 (except Management): A B2 level in English is recommended.

Incoming students can benefit from our partner’s dedicated student housing platform. They will have access to

Venir à l’ISIT
L’ISIT accueille de nombreux étudiants et professionnels internationaux, en formation longue, en échange académique ou dans le cadre d’écoles d’été destinées à mieux maîtriser les enjeux de l’interculturel. L’ISIT accueille également des étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Intégrer l’ISIT en échange universitaire
Former des talents pour le monde : cette vocation, l’ISIT la met également au service des étudiantes et étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Informations pratiques
Echanges internationaux 2025/2026
Date limite de dépôt des candidatures 2025/2026 :
14 avril 2025 (année complète et 1
er
semestre)
19 octobre 2025 (2
e
semestre)
Il est
fortement
recommandé aux étudiants d’effectuer leur
inscription rapidement
après avoir été contactés par l’ISIT car le processus d’acceptation peut prendre plusieurs semaines.
Une fois que les étudiants auront été inscrits, ils recevront une lettre d’acceptation qui leur permettra de demander un visa (pour ceux qui en ont besoin), réserver/payer leurs billets de déplacement et
réserver un logement
.
Les étudiants inscrits dans près de
100
établissements partenaires
dans le monde peuvent intégrer l’ISIT afin d’effectuer un ou deux semestres d’études, dans le cadre des programmes d’échange :
Erasmus+ « Etudes » (KA131)
Bilatéraux
L’ISIT a obtenu le
Label Bienvenue en France
,
gage de confiance, qui atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et des dispositifs mis en place pour des étudiantes et étudiants internationaux.
Ce label distingue les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français qui ont développé des dispositifs d’accueil mis à disposition des étudiants internationaux par les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français. Gage de confiance, le label atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et représente pour l’établissement un outil de promotion et de rayonnement.
3 points clés sur les échanges :
Durée
:
un semestre ou une année à l’ISIT, selon les critères de l’université d’origine.
Coût :
aucun droit de scolarité n’est versé à l’ISIT, les étudiants en échange payent leurs frais de scolarité à leur université d’origine.
Validation :
les étudiants en échange obtiennent des crédits transférables dans leur université d’origine. Le mode de validation des différents enseignements est expliqué
lors de l’inscription pédagogique
à l’ISIT.

Intégrer une Master de l’ISIT
Les candidats internationaux peuvent intégrer l’ISIT dans l’année correspondant à leur  niveau d’études validé dans leur pays d’origine.
Pour intégrer l’ISIT, les candidats doivent présenter un niveau C1 en français et en anglais.
Une troisième langue sera à choisir entre l’allemand, l’arabe, le chinois, l’espagnol, l’italien, le portugais et le russe. Toute autre langue peut faire l’objet d’un examen validé en fin de cursus.

Please read the following information carefully before choosing your courses. 
COURSE AVAILABILITY & VALIDATION
Exchange students should be aware that the module soffered in this catalogue can e modified in the event of extenuating circumstances and that enrolement in modules is subject to the availability of places. 
It should also be noted that there is no possibility for exchange students to compensate for any modules they have not validated (whether coursework-based or exam-based) unless the student in question is studying at ISIT the whole 
academic year, in which case they can retake a non-validated semester 1 module in semester 2 (if offered in semester 2). For this reason, students are strongly encouraged to take into consideration the language level required for each 
course.   
LANGUAGES, CULTURE AND METHODOLOGIES COURSES
Exchanges students should be aware that Oral Communication, Written Communication, Language Proficiency and Current Affairs Analysis and Debate classes are designed for students who are non-natives of the language of instruction. 
When working from French into their mother tongue, exchange students will be placed in Year 3 classes wherever possible. Whenworking from their mother tongue into French, students will be placed in either Year1 or Year 2 classes 
wherever possible, depending on their declared level of French or the number of years they have been studying French. It is recommended that exchange students do NOT choose specialised translation classes into French (even if the 
source language is their mother tongue) unless they have a level of French close or equivalent to C2. Exchange students are strongly recommended to ensure that at least one of the languages in their translation language combination is 
their mother tongue. 
Exchange students are reminded that the languages available for the different classes are dependent on there being ISIT students with the languages in question enrolled at the school in the specific year groups concerned. 
KEY REGARDING SEMESTERS 
S1: Modules taught during the 1st semester only (September to December) 
S2: Modules taught during the 2nd semester only (January to April) 
S1 + S2: Year-long modules that can be chosen in S1, S2 or both 
S1 or S2: Modules that can be chosen either in S1 or S2 but not both

地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

Venir à l’ISIT
L’ISIT accueille de nombreux étudiants et professionnels internationaux, en formation longue, en échange académique ou dans le cadre d’écoles d’été destinées à mieux maîtriser les enjeux de l’interculturel. L’ISIT accueille également des étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Intégrer l’ISIT en échange universitaire
Former des talents pour le monde : cette vocation, l’ISIT la met également au service des étudiantes et étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Informations pratiques
Echanges internationaux 2025/2026
Date limite de dépôt des candidatures 2025/2026 :
14 avril 2025 (année complète et 1
er
semestre)
19 octobre 2025 (2
e
semestre)
Il est
fortement
recommandé aux étudiants d’effectuer leur
inscription rapidement
après avoir été contactés par l’ISIT car le processus d’acceptation peut prendre plusieurs semaines.
Une fois que les étudiants auront été inscrits, ils recevront une lettre d’acceptation qui leur permettra de demander un visa (pour ceux qui en ont besoin), réserver/payer leurs billets de déplacement et
réserver un logement
.
Les étudiants inscrits dans près de
100
établissements partenaires
dans le monde peuvent intégrer l’ISIT afin d’effectuer un ou deux semestres d’études, dans le cadre des programmes d’échange :
Erasmus+ « Etudes » (KA131)
Bilatéraux
L’ISIT a obtenu le
Label Bienvenue en France
,
gage de confiance, qui atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et des dispositifs mis en place pour des étudiantes et étudiants internationaux.
Ce label distingue les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français qui ont développé des dispositifs d’accueil mis à disposition des étudiants internationaux par les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français. Gage de confiance, le label atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et représente pour l’établissement un outil de promotion et de rayonnement.
3 points clés sur les échanges :
Durée
:
un semestre ou une année à l’ISIT, selon les critères de l’université d’origine.
Coût :
aucun droit de scolarité n’est versé à l’ISIT, les étudiants en échange payent leurs frais de scolarité à leur université d’origine.
Validation :
les étudiants en échange obtiennent des crédits transférables dans leur université d’origine. Le mode de validation des différents enseignements est expliqué
lors de l’inscription pédagogique
à l’ISIT.

Intégrer une Master de l’ISIT
Les candidats internationaux peuvent intégrer l’ISIT dans l’année correspondant à leur  niveau d’études validé dans leur pays d’origine.
Pour intégrer l’ISIT, les candidats doivent présenter un niveau C1 en français et en anglais.
Une troisième langue sera à choisir entre l’allemand, l’arabe, le chinois, l’espagnol, l’italien, le portugais et le russe. Toute autre langue peut faire l’objet d’un examen validé en fin de cursus.

Academic Year 2024-2025
List of Modules Open to Undergraduate Exchange Students
Please read the following information carefully before choosing your courses. 
COURSE AVAILABILITY & VALIDATION
Exchange students should be aware that the module soffered in this catalogue can e modified in the event of extenuating circumstances and that enrolement in modules is subject to the availability of places. 
It should also be noted that there is no possibility for exchange students to compensate for any modules they have not validated (whether coursework-based or exam-based) unless the student in question is studying at ISIT the whole 
academic year, in which case they can retake a non-validated semester 1 module in semester 2 (if offered in semester 2). For this reason, students are strongly encouraged to take into consideration the language level required for each 
course.   
LANGUAGES, CULTURE AND METHODOLOGIES COURSES
Exchanges students should be aware that Oral Communication, Written Communication, Language Proficiency and Current Affairs Analysis and Debate classes are designed for students who are non-natives of the language of instruction. 
When working from French into their mother tongue, exchange students will be placed in Year 3 classes wherever possible. Whenworking from their mother tongue into French, students will be placed in either Year1 or Year 2 classes 
wherever possible, depending on their declared level of French or the number of years they have been studying French. It is recommended that exchange students do NOT choose specialised translation classes into French (even if the 
source language is their mother tongue) unless they have a level of French close or equivalent to C2. Exchange students are strongly recommended to ensure that at least one of the languages in their translation language combination is 
their mother tongue. 
Exchange students are reminded that the languages available for the different classes are dependent on there being ISIT students with the languages in question enrolled at the school in the specific year groups concerned. 
KEY REGARDING SEMESTERS 
S1: Modules taught during the 1st semester only (September to December) 
S2: Modules taught during the 2nd semester only (January to April) 
S1 + S2: Year-long modules that can be chosen in S1, S2 or both 
S1 or S2: Modules that can be chosen either in S1 or S2 but not both

F) During your stay in France
Your student experience at ISIT
The campus
• The ISIT campus reflects the multicultural identity of its students 
and staff. The school building is divided into three floors, a ground 
floor, and a basement (where the Media Center is located). Each 
floor has been named after a continent. Each classroom is named 
after a major metropolis. The ISIT facilities are at the cutting edge 
of modern technology. The administrative, financial and 
pedagogical staff are located on the third floor.
How are the classes organized ? 
• Classes are prepared by university professors and professional 
lecturers. They teach in several languages and propose a content 
adapted to the needs of companies and international organizations. 
• Attendance and participation in class are mandatory. Students 
submit work throughout the semester and can have exams at the 
end of it to validate modules. 
• In France, grades are given on a scale of 0 to 20 and students are 
expected to have more than the average 10/20. Thus, students must 
obtain a minimum of 30 European credits (ECTS) to validate a 
semester, 60 ECTS for an academic year.

Venir à l’ISIT
L’ISIT accueille de nombreux étudiants et professionnels internationaux, en formation longue, en échange académique ou dans le cadre d’écoles d’été destinées à mieux maîtriser les enjeux de l’interculturel. L’ISIT accueille également des étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Intégrer l’ISIT en échange universitaire
Former des talents pour le monde : cette vocation, l’ISIT la met également au service des étudiantes et étudiants de nos universités partenaires, en Europe et hors Europe
Informations pratiques
Echanges internationaux 2025/2026
Date limite de dépôt des candidatures 2025/2026 :
14 avril 2025 (année complète et 1
er
semestre)
19 octobre 2025 (2
e
semestre)
Il est
fortement
recommandé aux étudiants d’effectuer leur
inscription rapidement
après avoir été contactés par l’ISIT car le processus d’acceptation peut prendre plusieurs semaines.
Une fois que les étudiants auront été inscrits, ils recevront une lettre d’acceptation qui leur permettra de demander un visa (pour ceux qui en ont besoin), réserver/payer leurs billets de déplacement et
réserver un logement
.
Les étudiants inscrits dans près de
100
établissements partenaires
dans le monde peuvent intégrer l’ISIT afin d’effectuer un ou deux semestres d’études, dans le cadre des programmes d’échange :
Erasmus+ « Etudes » (KA131)
Bilatéraux
L’ISIT a obtenu le
Label Bienvenue en France
,
gage de confiance, qui atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et des dispositifs mis en place pour des étudiantes et étudiants internationaux.
Ce label distingue les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français qui ont développé des dispositifs d’accueil mis à disposition des étudiants internationaux par les établissements d’enseignement supérieur français. Gage de confiance, le label atteste de la qualité de l’accueil et représente pour l’établissement un outil de promotion et de rayonnement.
3 points clés sur les échanges :
Durée
:
un semestre ou une année à l’ISIT, selon les critères de l’université d’origine.
Coût :
aucun droit de scolarité n’est versé à l’ISIT, les étudiants en échange payent leurs frais de scolarité à leur université d’origine.
Validation :
les étudiants en échange obtiennent des crédits transférables dans leur université d’origine. Le mode de validation des différents enseignements est expliqué
lors de l’inscription pédagogique
à l’ISIT.

Intégrer une Master de l’ISIT
Les candidats internationaux peuvent intégrer l’ISIT dans l’année correspondant à leur  niveau d’études validé dans leur pays d’origine.
Pour intégrer l’ISIT, les candidats doivent présenter un niveau C1 en français et en anglais.
Une troisième langue sera à choisir entre l’allemand, l’arabe, le chinois, l’espagnol, l’italien, le portugais et le russe. Toute autre langue peut faire l’objet d’un examen validé en fin de cursus.

 Finding accommodation
Student residences
Finding accommodation in Paris and its suburbs can be a long and stressful process. 
We recommend that you start looking will before September. We also warn students never to send a sum of money if they are 
not 100% sure that the accommodation is guaranteed. 
ISIT has partnerships with several student residences. They are however very popular, and the number of rooms is limited. We 
advise you to contact the residences as soon as your ISIT registration is confirmed. You will usually need to provide a pre -
registration certificate or a school certificate.

Visa
Mandatory
insurances 
British and Non-European students must get a visa to study in France. 
In order to apply for a visa, students shall provide their current passport (valid for the
duration of stay) and their acceptance letter. 
If you live in one of the 44 countries subject to the "Études en France" ("Studies in
France") procedure, you must first apply to enroll in a higher education institution
through the platform "Études en France". Your visa application will be automatically
sent to the “Campus France office” of your home country through the platform. 
For example, the following countries are all using the “Studies in France” 
procedure: Argentina, Chile, China, Colombia, Lebanon, Mexico, Morocco, 
Russia, Senegal, South Korea, Taiwan and the United-States. 
If you do not live in one of those countries and you need a visa to come and 
study in France, please contact the French consular authorities in your home 
country. 
Some consulates ask for an IELTS or a TOEFL proving a B2 level in English. 
Please also contact the French consular authorities in your home country. 
TIPS: Follow this link to see if you need a visa or not: 
https://france-visas.gouv.fr/web/france-visas/accueil 
If you get a (VLS-TS, visa long séjour valant de titre de séjour) 
You have until three months after the day of your arrival in France to validate 
your long-stay visa: 
→ https://www.campusfrance.org/en/how-to-validate-your-long-stay-visa- 
visa-long-sejour-upon-your-arrival-in-france Please note that it will cost you 
50€ 
Practical information 
Three insurances are compulsory in France: 
      ✓  Health insurance: 
*If you are a European student, you will have to provide your European Health 
Insurance Card (EHIC) 
*If you are a British or a non-European student, you will have to register 
online at https://etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr/#/.
Signing up via this website before going to France will allow you to apply for
membership in the French social security system. The French Social Security system
will reimburse you for your health care expenses. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qEpy9Xr9UKk
In addition, we highly recommend subscribing to a top-up (complementary) health
insurance policy in order to ensure optimal reimbursement of healthcare expenses.
This would be interesting for reimbursement with dentists, opticians, medical
specialists or to cover possible hospital fees. 
ISIT – Institut de Management et de Communication Interculturels 
Etablissement d’Enseignement Supérieur Privé d’Intérêt Général 
Centre International : 39 bis rue d’Assas 75006 Paris / Campus Arcueil : 23/25 avenue Jeanne d’Arc 94110 Arcueil 
Tél : 33 (1) 42 22 58 22 –direction@isit-paris.fr – www.isit-paris.fr 
Association loi 1901 – SIREN : 784 280 836 – Code APE 8559B 
✓  Housing insurance (compulsory for all students whether you live in a student
residence or choose private rental housing): covers all damages that your home
may suffer or that you may cause to your neighbors (fire, water damage, natural
disaster, etc) 
✓  Civil liability insurance (generally included with the home insurance but please
double-check): covers potential damage to another person or property

original_evidence.text:
C) Health insurance
It is important for you to be covered by health insurance for the entire duration of your stay in France. This will enable yo u to be 
reimbursed for your health expenses as well as expenses in case of more serious problems.
The health protection required by ISIT depends on your home country :
Option A :
You come from a country outside the EU/EEA/Switzerland, or you are a French citizen from Wallis and Futuna, or a 
French citizen born abroad.
Before arriving in France, you must subscribe to health insurance, either from your home country or a French provider. Since 
public health insurance ( L’Assurance Maladie ) doesn’t cover all medical costs, including serious illness and hospitalization, 
supplementary private health insurance (assurance maladie complémentaire ) is required. 
For example : Kinousassur , April, or Heyme .

C) Health insurance
Option A :
CPAM
• At your arrival in France, you will also have to register with the CPAM 
(Caisse Primaire d'Assurance Maladie , local sickness insurance fund) 
on the website:
https://etudiant -etranger.ameli.fr/

CARTE VITALE
• The carte vitale will always be needed at the doctor’s practice or at the pharmacy. It will enable you to be reimbursed for

original_evidence.text:
D) Additional insurances
Home insurance  (‘assurance logement’ or ‘assurance 
habitation’ or ‘assurance multirisques’) 
Home insurance is mandatory for all tenants in
France, regardless of their status or
accommodation type . It covers risks like fire and
water damage . If you live in a student
residence, it may be included, while private
landlords may help arrange it.
Civil Liability  insurance  (assurance 
responsabilité civile)
Regardless of their home country, all students
must take out a ‘civil liability insurance’ that is
valid for the duration of their stay in France . This
insurance policy will cover any costs arising from
bodily injury or property damage that you may
accidentally cause in day-to-day life . For
example, if you knock your classmate’s glasses
onto the floor and they break, or you knock a
classmate over while playing football and he
breaks his leg.
Note : This insurance is almost always
included in your home insurance contract

Your situation
• You are a citizen of a country of the European Economic Area (EEA)*, Switzerland, Monaco or Andorra: You do not need a 
visa, no matter how long you stay. Your passport or identity card is all you need to enter French territory.

original_evidence.text:
A) Immigration
Your visa
• VLS-T visa
VLS-T visa (temporary long -stay student visa): 4 to 12 months. It allows you to travel throughout the Schengen Area and benefit 
from the Sécurité Sociale . 
However, you are not allowed to work during your stay and you are not allowed to extend your stay beyond the validity of your
visa. To continue studying in France, they must return to their home country and re -apply for a visa). 
• VLS-TS visa
VLS-TS visa (long -stay student visa equivalent to a residence permit): 4 to 12 months. 
It allows you to travel throughout the Schengen Area and benefit from the Sécurité Sociale . 
You are also allowed to work during your exchange within the limit of authorized hours (max 20 hours per week = 964 hours per
year). 
If you wish to extend your stay, you will need renew your visa no later than two months before it expires, we strongly advise you 
to start the procedure four months in advance. 
Caution : 
If you have a VLS -TS visa, you will need to validate your visa within three months. This procedure is mandatory. Do not 
forget to gather important personal information including your email address, your visa information, your arrival date in 
France, etc. The procedure is entirely online via this link : 
https://administration -etrangers -en-france.interieur.gouv.fr/particuliers/#/ . 
We recommend printing and keeping the validation confirmation of your visa. It can be useful in other situations.
